description:

name: Repair bag, custom print and layout
heading: Repair bag, custom print and layout , 110 x 240 mm
variant: Yellow paper bag with black print
description:
Whether you do your own repairs or send them to a third party, repair bags never come amiss if you're running a jewellery shop. This repair bag is available in white or yellow.
Order these repair bags if you need jewellery repair bags with a fully customised lay-out, with perforation 78 mm from the top. However, you have the option for one or more perforations, which can be placed wherever you desire, for an additional fee. The minimum order quantity is just 1000 pcs. The bags are sturdy and are perfect as an inexpensive storage of jewellery repairs.
The bags may be numbered, so both you and the customer get parts of the bag with the same number. Basically, you decide exactly how you would the bags to look.
Please specify in the comment field in the shopping cart, the starting number you wish your repair bags to have, and attach your file with the desired layout. If you require special perforations or additional ones, please also indicate this in the comment field. Our sales department will then add the fee to your order.

name: Ribbon from wooden pulp, with smooth print
heading: Ribbon from wooden pulp, with smooth print
description:
Make your gift-wrap stand out from the crowd by using personalised printed ribbon. Great for jewellery packaging and corporate gifts. Personalised ribbon conveys a professional and sophisticated image.
Apart from having a high fibre strength, the ribbon has a nice, smooth surface. When you feel the ribbon, you are surprised by its similarity to polyester, but this ribbon is made entirely from wooden pulp.
Logs of wood are turned into pulp, which is turned into fibres through a smart chemical (and environmentally harmless) process. The fibres are then used to create a yarn that is weaved to make the ribbon, also called Lyocell ribbon.
Lyocell fibre is biodegradable. Under certain circumstances, it can be wholly composted.
